blocks.text: Join Us at Dance Institute Today

At Dance Institute, we are passionate about teaching dance to students aged 2 to adult. Our extensive curriculum includes Ballet, Tap, Lyrical, Contemporary, Pointe, Hip-Hop, Poms, Acro, Tumbling, and Jazz. We create a nurturing environment where students not only learn to dance but also develop confidence, dedication and self awareness.
Unlock your potential through our diverse offerings, designed to inspire creativity and artistic expression.
Our students gain valuable experiences through performances, building confidence and stage presence in a supportive setting.

"My daughter has grown up with a love of dance from a young age thanks to 5+ years with Dance Institute LLC and Ms. Michele. Dance Institute LLC has offered the perfect balance for our young dancer — great instruction and progressive growth with a relaxed, family-friendly, non-competitive atmosphere. I highly recommend Ms. Michele and Dance Institute"

"Dance with Miss Michele is the highlight of my (4 year old) daughter's week. This is her second year dancing and, not only does she continue to love it, but aslso she is learning all the basics at a young age.  Michele does a great job meeting her young students where they are and steadily teaching them skills poise , and positions while they smile and dance the hour away."
"Every class at Dance Institute is an opportunity to express myself and improve my skills. I love being part of this amazing dance family!"
At Dance Institute, we combine expert instruction with a warm, welcoming atmosphere, ensuring that every dancer, regardless of age or skill level, feels valued and inspired.
Our dedicated instructors are focused on each student's growth, emphasizing health and safety while fostering a love for dance.
We welcome your inquiries about classes, admissions, or any questions you may have. Reach out to us and let’s embark on this dance journey together.

blocks.text: Join us in the world of ballet, where elegance meets discipline. Our ballet classes nurture students from ages 2 to adult, focusing on key techniques that promote strength, flexibility, and artistic expression. Whether you're a beginner or an advanced dancer, we support your journey with personalized guidance.

Step into the vibrant world of hip-hop! Our hip-hop classes are designed to engage students in rhythm and movement, allowing them to express themselves through energetic choreography. Suitable for all skill levels, these classes foster creativity and confidence on the dance floor.

Our acro and tumbling program combines dance with gymnastics, helping students develop strength and agility. We focus on safe techniques to perform stunning tricks and flips, encouraging students to push their limits while having fun and building lifelong friendships.

blocks.text: The explanations and information provided on this page are only general and high-level explanations and information on how to write your own document of a Privacy Policy. You should not rely on this article as legal advice or as recommendations regarding what you should actually do, because we cannot know in advance what are the specific privacy policies you wish to establish between your business and your customers and visitors. We recommend that you seek legal advice to help you understand and to assist you in the creation of your own Privacy Policy.

Having said that, a privacy policy is a statement that discloses some or all of the ways a website collects, uses, discloses, processes, and manages the data of its visitors and customers. It usually also includes a statement regarding the website’s commitment to protecting its visitors’ or customers’ privacy, and an explanation about the different mechanisms the website is implementing in order to protect privacy.

Different jurisdictions have different legal obligations of what must be included in a Privacy Policy. You are responsible to make sure you are following the relevant legislation to your activities and location.
What to include in the Privacy Policy

Generally speaking, a Privacy Policy often addresses these types of issues: the types of information the website is collecting and the manner in which it collects the data; an explanation about why is the website collecting these types of information; what are the website’s practices on sharing the information with third parties; ways in which your visitors and customers can exercise their rights according to the relevant privacy legislation; the specific practices regarding minors’ data collection; and much, much more.
To learn more about this, check out our article “Creating a Privacy Policy”.

ACCESSIBILITY STATEMENT

This statement was last updated on [enter relevant date]. We at Dance Institute are committed to making our studio and website accessible to all individuals, ensuring everyone can engage with our dance programs.

What web accessibility is

An accessible platform allows everyone, regardless of ability, to participate in our dance classes and activities with ease and enjoyment. Our goal is to accommodate all students, ensuring they have equal access to our resources.

Accessibility adjustments on this site

We have adapted our website in accordance with WCAG 2.1 guidelines and have made it accessible to the level of AA. Our site is compatible with assistive technologies, such as screen readers, to enhance the user experience for all visitors.



Utilized accessibility tools to identify and rectify issues


Set the language for our site 


Organized content for easy navigation


Established clear headings on all pages


Provided alternative text for images


Ensured color contrast meets accessibility standards


Minimized motion effects on the site


Made sure all multimedia content is accessible

Our studio locations are equipped with ramps and designated parking for individuals with disabilities. We ensure that all spaces, including classrooms and restrooms, are accessible and welcoming. Additional support services are available upon request.
